response.sql: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as group_avg FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != '' GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as avg_of_avgs FROM group_avgs) SELECT g.death_country, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.avg_of_avgs as diff_from_avg FROM group_avgs g CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
